A small '''Imperial outpost''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] was in operation by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The facility was guarded by a number of [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] and staffed by a [[Surface Marshal]].<ref name="AED" /> Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] visited the outpost to recover a [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|scout trooper armor]] [[Belt/Legends|utility belt]].<ref name="SWG:LISTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Imperial Scout Trooper Armor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial outpost on Rori was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="AED" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
